meta.name: Hermes Agent Website DNA
meta.description: Design DNA extracted from the rendered Hermes Agent marketing site for reuse as a reference style, not a clone.

color.palette_type: monochrome electric-blue with white editorial contrast

primary.role: full-bleed brand field, section background, dominant identity color

secondary.role: primary text, engraved line art, icons, reversed UI chrome

accent.role: rare high-energy accent token observed in CSS, not dominant in captured hero

neutral.usage: white/off-white for typography and cards, pale lavender-gray inside product screenshot surfaces, primary blue as the only large color field

color.contrast_strategy: Extreme two-tone contrast: saturated blue field against white text and white engraved imagery. Controls invert to white cards with blue text.

font_families.heading: High-contrast editorial display serif similar to Didot/Bodoni/Times Display
font_families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

typography.font_style_notes: Identity comes from all-caps editorial serif headings, tiny tracked uppercase metadata, and monospace terminal commands.

spacing.content_density: Sparse hero with large negative space; dense only inside terminal and product screenshot components.
spacing.section_rhythm: Large viewport-height blocks with strong vertical gaps; content aligns to generous left margins.

layout.grid_system: Full-bleed viewport sections with a top horizontal nav, left-aligned hero copy, right-dominant illustration, and below-fold card/grid feature sections.
layout.max_content_width: none for hero field; content columns visually constrained to roughly 520px on desktop
layout.columns: 2-column hero: left content rail plus right illustration/art rail; feature sections use repeated media/text panels.
layout.alignment_tendency: Left-aligned functional content balanced by centered top logo and right-heavy hero art.

shape.border_usage: Most links and nav are borderless. Terminal card uses a subtle white/gray boundary; product screenshots are framed by their own image edges.
shape.divider_style: Thin, low-contrast dividers inside terminal/tabs; no heavy section rules.

elevation.shadow_style: Minimal; depth mostly comes from scale, cropping, and high-contrast line art. Terminal card has a soft practical shadow.
elevation.depth_cues: Illustration overlap, radiating linework, card inversion, and screenshot cropping rather than stacked shadows.

iconography.style: Simple white platform/social glyphs plus ornate engraved hero illustration
iconography.stroke_weight: 1.5-2px for UI icons; hairline to medium engraved strokes for artwork
iconography.preferred_set: Lucide-like thin UI icons paired with custom engraved mythological artwork

motion.entrance_pattern: No visible entrance motion in captured still; likely simple fades/slides if present.
motion.exit_pattern: No visible exit motion in captured still.
motion.philosophy: Motion is secondary; static brand impact carries the page.

components.button_style: Text-link buttons with uppercase serif labels; key download action pairs a platform icon with small text. Primary command card is a white rounded terminal surface.
components.input_style: Terminal/code card rather than form inputs: white field, compact tabs, blue monospace command text.
components.card_style: Few real cards; when present, white/off-white rectangles on blue with small radius and restrained shadow.
components.navigation_pattern: Wide top nav spread across the page, centered stacked brand mark, small social icons underneath.
components.modal_style: Not observed; if needed, use stark blue backdrop with white panel and editorial serif heading.
components.list_style: Feature list uses numbered sections (#1, #2...) with image plus concise copy; labels are tiny uppercase.
components.component_notes: Reusable units: hero art block, top nav wordmarks, terminal install card, platform download tiles, numbered feature panels.

aesthetic.mood: mythic, electric, editorial, open-source, technically ceremonial
aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A classical messenger/deity fused with developer terminal ritual and desktop-agent product proof.
aesthetic.era_influence: High-fashion editorial typography plus 1980s/1990s developer terminal cues and classical engraving.
aesthetic.genre: AI developer-tool marketing page with editorial art direction

visual_language.complexity: Medium-high: layout is simple, but artwork and typographic voice are highly distinctive.
visual_language.ornamentation: High in illustration/radiating motifs, low in UI chrome.
visual_language.whitespace_usage: Large, dramatic negative space around hero copy; dense command card only where function matters.
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Dominant color field and massive serif headline balanced by oversized right-side illustration.
visual_language.focal_strategy: Hero headline first, mythological art second, terminal install card third.
visual_language.texture_usage: Engraved line texture in hero artwork; otherwise flat color.

composition.hierarchy_method: Scale, all-caps serif contrast, whitespace, and color inversion.
composition.balance_type: Asymmetric hero with centered nav anchor.
composition.flow_direction: Top nav → left hero headline → install/download card → platform/feature proof sections.
composition.grouping_strategy: Sparse labeled clusters; each cluster gets a tiny uppercase label before the functional element.
composition.negative_space_role: Primary; empty blue field makes typography and artwork feel monumental.

imagery.photo_treatment: No photography observed; product screenshots are lightly washed/pale and embedded as proof artifacts.
imagery.illustration_style: Classical engraved mythological figure, monochrome white/blue, with radiating geometric bursts.
imagery.graphic_elements: Sunburst rays, line-art figure, platform glyphs, terminal card, product screenshots.
imagery.pattern_usage: No repeating pattern; radial burst linework acts as local ornament.
imagery.image_shape: Large irregular illustration cutout; rectangular screenshot crops.

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Likely minimal text/link hover states; still capture shows no overt animation state.
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Expected subtle opacity/color changes, not chunky transforms.
interaction_feel.loading_style: Not observed; should use simple typographic or terminal-like feedback if adapted.

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: Command-oriented: Install, Download, terminal curl command.
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Not observed; adapt with concise technical copy and tiny uppercase labels.
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Not observed; use calm terminal-style diagnostics.

overview.fallback_strategy: Static blue field, static line art, and ordinary white cards must preserve identity if all motion/effects are disabled.
overview.primary_technology: CSS plus raster/WebP artwork; no confirmed WebGL/canvas from captured evidence.

particle_systems.description: No particle system visible in rendered screenshot.

3d_elements.description: No live 3D renderer visible; mythological figure is rendered as static image/line art.

shader_effects.description: No shader distortion visible in the screenshot.

scroll_morphing.description: No scroll morphing observed from still capture.

text_effects.description: Impact comes from large all-caps serif type, tight line-height, and wide tracking rather than animated text.

cursor_effects.description: No custom cursor visible or inferred from screenshot.

image_effects.description: Static WebP/raster artwork treated as white/blue engraving over a solid blue field.

canvas_drawings.description: No canvas drawing visible in rendered screenshot.

svg_animations.description: SVG icons appear static; no SVG path animation observed.

visual_effects.composite_notes: Hermes' reusable DNA is not generic blue SaaS. It is a specific combination: electric-blue flood, monumental high-contrast serif type, tiny uppercase labels, static engraved mythological art, developer terminal card, and sparse UI chrome. For Slotok/Hermes-inspired internal work, reuse the composition logic and typographic drama without copying the Hermes name, exact illustration, or brand-blue dominance unless making a separate reference-mode experiment.
